Slaid Cleaves: Slaid Cleaves (born June 9, 1964) is an American singer-songwriter born in Washington, D.C. and raised in South Berwick, Maine and Round Pond, Maine, United States.  An alumnus of Tufts University, where he majored in English and philosophy, Cleaves lives in Austin, Texas.
